title: Labeled apartment-tritangent transport, eight-orbital Steinberg factorization, Jacobian/code bridge, sparse apartment decoding, apartment stabilizers, and three outside-box probes
purpose: Execute the five queued continuations from Pass5028-5035 plus three independent probes. Pass5036 materializes the labeled cover/tritangent and apartment/tritangent operators. Pass5037 resolves the Steinberg projector into the eight FF orbitals. Pass5038 compares the subdivision critical group with binary/quadratic code carriers. Pass5039 builds sparse apartment encoders/decoders and erasure bounds. Pass5040 identifies apartment stabilizers and fuses them with existing local-control groups. Pass5041-5043 are three outside-box probes chosen after the exact structure is visible.
boundary: Finite incidence, module, code, critical-group and group-action statements only; no physical or exceptional-group identification is promoted from matching counts without an explicit map.
